instruction:
On the NASA Exoplanet Archive overview for HD 209458 b, use only the Architecture & Discovery Information block. Report the stellar-host name, planet name, value under Orbital Separation, value under Planet Size, discovery method, discovery year, reference, and disposition.

Stopping condition: Stop after the single Architecture & Discovery Information row and all eight requested fields have been recorded.

Constraints:
- Use only the Architecture & Discovery Information block on the supplied overview page.
- Do not substitute literature values from the separate Planetary Parameters table.
- Preserve labels, numbers, units, names, and disposition exactly as displayed.
- Do not infer mass or convert the displayed values.
